css: .grouped-col { position:absolute; top:300px; width:176px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px }.grouped-col h4 { margin:0 0 4px; font-size:22px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.1em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--mute); text-align:center }.grouped-m { box-sizing:border-box; height:96px; padding:12px 14px; border-radius:14px; background:var(--tile); border:2px solid var(--hair); font-size:22px; line-height:1.25; font-weight:500; display:flex; align-items:center; box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.05) }.grouped-m.on { border-color:var(--accent); border-width:3px; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, var(--tile)) }.grouped-pair { left:1159px; top:126px } .grouped-note { position:absolute; left:1560px; top:180px; font-size:20px; color:var(--mute) }
